literal: Water without does not exist world if said, who to anyone sky without does not exist conduct.
translation: If it is said that the world cannot exist without water, then for anyone at all, proper conduct cannot exist without the rain.
modern: நீர் இல்லாமல் இந்த உலகம் அமையாது என்றால், மழை இல்லாமல் எவருக்கும் நல்லொழுக்கம் அமையாது.
explanation: This couplet establishes the absolute necessity of rain for both physical survival and moral order. The word 'நீர்' (water) represents the basic element required for the world ('உலகு') to function. Just as the physical world cannot exist without water, the poet argues that 'ஒழுக்கு' (proper conduct or moral order) cannot be maintained by anyone ('யார் யார்க்கும்') without 'வான்' (the sky, meaning rain). Thus, rain is shown as the foundation of both life and virtue.
